questions.q: The Nile helps farmers because it gives them ______.
questions.passage: The Nile River is one of the longest rivers in the world. It flows through many countries in Africa, including Egypt. The river has been very important for people since ancient times. Farmers use its water to grow crops like wheat, rice, and vegetables. The Nile also gives water for drinking and helps produce electricity through dams. Boats travel on the river to move people and goods from place to place. Many visitors come to see the Nile because it is a famous part of history. Without the Nile, life in Egypt would be much harder.
